Adeka Al Ghurair Additives LLC.note: ADEKA Corporation acquired a majority stake in Al Ghurair Additives LLC to establish it as a joint venture named Adeka Al Ghurair Additives LLC.

Galata Chemicals LLC.note: Artek Surfin Chemicals acquired the remaining 50% shares from joint venture partner Aterian Investment Partners to take full ownership of Galata Chemicals.

Química Pesquería, S.A. de C.V..note: Grupo Industrial Trébol (GIT) acquired Química Pesquería in 2015 to form part of its Chemical Division.

Advtec Aditivos.note: Advtec Aditivos is an independent company founded in 2017 with 100% Brazilian national capital, operating in the manufacture of industrial chemical additives.

Carboquímica S.A.S..note: The company is owned by Grupo Sanford and continues to operate in the production and distribution of chemical solutions in Colombia.

Double Bond Chemical Ind. Co., Ltd..note: Double Bond Chemical Ind. Co., Ltd. remains an independent publicly listed company in Taiwan and has not been acquired.

Fine Organic Industries Limited.note: Fine Organic Industries Limited remains an independent, promoter-led publicly traded company and has not been acquired.

Mayzo, Inc..note: Mayzo, Inc. remains an independent, privately held company owned by its founder, Ben Milazzo, and has not been acquired.

Polystell do Brasil Indústria e Comércio.note: Polystell do Brasil Indústria e Comércio S.A. operates as an independent Brazilian producer of chemical additives and specialities with no record of acquisition.

SRB Químicos, S.A. de C.V..note: SRB Químicos, S.A. de C.V. remains an independent, 100% Mexican company founded in 2009 that distributes chemical additives and raw materials.

Thinh Loi Hoa Viet Nam Rubber Limited Co.note: The company remains operational as an importer and exporter of rubber additives and stabilizers, with no records of any acquisition.

Baerlocher GmbH.note: Baerlocher GmbH is a privately owned company that restructured its operations in 2026, transferring its European operational business into a newly established wholly owned subsidiary called Baerlocher Germany GmbH & Co. KG.

Everlight Chemical Industrial Corporatio.note: Everlight Chemical Industrial Corporation remains an independent corporation focused on chemical additives, including light stabilizers, UV absorbers, and antioxidants.

Parabor Produtos para Indústria de Borra.note: Parabor has operated independently since 1964 as a manufacturer and distributor of raw materials and laboratory equipment for the rubber and plastics industry.

Syensqo SA.note: Syensqo SA was established as an independent public company in December 2023 following a partial demerger and spin-off of the specialty activities from Solvay.
